summary: Addex Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K furnishing a November 11, 2026 press release disclosing that its spin-out Neurosterix closed a $105 million Series B financing led by a syndicate of life-science investors. Addex did not participate; its retained equity interest now equals 8.5% of Neurosterix issued capital, carried at an $18.6 million valuation. Proceeds mainly fund planned Phase 2 development of NTX-253, an M4 positive allosteric modulator for schizophrenia, plus the broader pipeline. No board recommendation, advisor, price per share, premium, or closing date is stated; the filing is a portfolio-update rather than a discrete special situation.
